categories.description: A right triggered when one party undergoes a change of ownership or control — consent requirements, termination rights, or accelerated obligations on a deal.
categories.name: Change of Control

categories.description: A restriction on assigning or transferring the contract or its rights, including on a merger or sale of the business, and any consent needed.
categories.name: Anti-Assignment

categories.description: An obligation making one party the exclusive provider or purchaser, or barring dealings with third parties.
categories.name: Exclusivity

categories.description: A restriction on competing in a business, market, territory, or with a customer set.
categories.name: Non-Compete

categories.description: A liability that is not subject to a cap, or that is carved out of an existing cap.
categories.name: Uncapped Liability

categories.description: A limit on the amount or type of liability a party bears under the contract.
categories.name: Cap on Liability

categories.description: A right to terminate — for convenience, for cause, on notice, or on an event.
categories.name: Termination Rights

categories.description: Who owns or is assigned intellectual property created or licensed under the contract, including missing or ambiguous assignment.
categories.name: IP Ownership / Assignment

categories.description: A grant of a licence to intellectual property, its scope, and exclusivity.
categories.name: IP Licence Grant

categories.description: A right to terms at least as favourable as those given to any third party.
categories.name: Most Favoured Nation

categories.description: The jurisdiction whose law governs the contract.
categories.name: Governing Law

categories.description: An obligation to compensate the other party for specified losses or third-party claims.
categories.name: Indemnification

categories.description: The survival period of representations and warranties, or a warranty's duration.
categories.name: Warranty / Rep Duration

categories.description: A minimum purchase, volume, or spend obligation.
categories.name: Minimum Commitment

categories.description: A restriction or trigger on pricing — most-favoured pricing, renegotiation, or price adjustment rights.
categories.name: Price / Renegotiation

categories.description: A right for one party to audit the books, records, or performance of the other.
categories.name: Audit Rights

categories.description: An obligation of confidentiality or non-disclosure and its scope.
categories.name: Confidentiality

categories.description: The effective date, initial term, and any automatic renewal of the contract.
categories.name: Term / Effective Date

classify_context: You are triaging one document from an M&A data room against a due-diligence information request list. Read the excerpt and decide which single document type it is. England & Wales / US commercial context.

document_types.description: The principal transaction document — a share purchase agreement, asset purchase agreement, merger agreement, or term sheet / heads of terms for the deal itself.
document_types.name: Share / Asset Purchase Agreement

document_types.description: Articles of association, certificate of incorporation, bylaws, charter, or other formation and governance documents of the target.
document_types.name: Constitutional Documents

document_types.description: Shareholders' agreements, investors' rights agreements, voting agreements, or subscription agreements among the target's owners.
document_types.name: Shareholder / Investment Agreements

document_types.description: The capitalisation table, share register, option ledger, or any schedule of the target's issued securities and their holders.
document_types.name: Cap Table / Share Register

document_types.description: Minutes of board or shareholder meetings, written resolutions, or consents of directors or members.
document_types.name: Board Minutes / Resolutions

document_types.description: Revenue-side agreements — master service agreements, sales or subscription agreements, statements of work with customers.
document_types.name: Customer Contracts

document_types.description: Cost-side agreements — supply, procurement, distribution, reseller, or outsourcing agreements with vendors.
document_types.name: Supplier / Vendor Contracts

document_types.description: Employment contracts, offer letters, consulting or contractor agreements, and severance or separation agreements.
document_types.name: Employment Agreements

document_types.description: Share option plans, RSU or bonus schemes, phantom equity, or other employee incentive arrangements and their grant documents.
document_types.name: Incentive / Equity Plans

document_types.description: Assignments of intellectual property to the target — invention assignments, work-for-hire confirmations, or IP transfer deeds.
document_types.name: IP Assignments

document_types.description: Licences of intellectual property granted to or by the target — software licences, patent or trademark licences, technology agreements.
document_types.name: IP Licences (In / Out)

document_types.description: Leases, subleases, or licences of real property occupied or owned by the target.
document_types.name: Real Property Leases

document_types.description: Insurance policies, schedules, certificates of coverage, or broker summaries.
document_types.name: Insurance Policies

document_types.description: Pleadings, claim letters, settlement agreements, regulatory correspondence, or any document evidencing an actual or threatened dispute.
document_types.name: Litigation / Disputes

document_types.description: Audited or management accounts — balance sheets, income statements, cash-flow statements, or auditor reports.
document_types.name: Financial Statements

document_types.description: Tax returns, assessments, clearances, rulings, or correspondence with tax authorities.
document_types.name: Tax Documents
